<a id="schema-setactiveemailconfigurationcommand"></a>
### SetActiveEmailConfigurationCommand

Sets the single active email profile. Id null/0 deactivates all (the connector then uses the
Azure/SES default). Deactivation is committed before activation so the DB filtered unique index
on IsActive never sees two active rows at once.

Required: _none_

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 |  |  |
